purpose: Per-bibitem record of WHICH assertion the reference backs and HOW that was verified. A gate that only checks references exist cannot catch a real, resolvable reference cited for a claim it does not make.
rules: Transcribe from the paper's own title block or publisher page. Never from memory, a search result, or another paper's reference list.
source_of_number: if a number attributed to this work was actually read somewhere else, name that source. Leaving it null asserts the number came from the cited work itself.
venue_status: published | preprint_only | ambiguous. 'ambiguous' fails the gate by design.
An unfilled entry FAILS. That is intended: the file starts as a checklist, not a certificate.
